title: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Applications of Microarrays in Heart Transplantation
official: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Applications of Microarrays in Heart Transplantation, a Multicenter Study (INTERHEART)
summary: Demonstrate the impact of the Molecular Microscope Diagnostic System as the standard of care for heart transplant patients.
criteria:

* biopsy for clinical indications
